sloka: पितरं गुरुभूतं मां यस्मात्त्वमवमन्यसे ।राक्षसान्यातुधानांस्त्वं जनयिष्यसि दारुणान् ।। ७.५९.१५ ॥
transliteration: pitaraṁ gurubhūtaṁ māṁ yasmāttvamavamanyase ।rākṣasānyātudhānāṁstvaṁ janayiṣyasi dāruṇān ।। 7.59.15 ॥

translations.english: Because you disrespect me, your father and preceptor, you will give birth to terrible Rakshasas and Yatudhanas.
